mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate of more than 0.2 percentage points signals a tightening labor market, which supports stronger economic growth and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust aggregate demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS and HOUST both above 90th percentile) fails to predict positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 indicates manufacturing supply chain disruption, which leads to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the past six months indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The correlation between PAYEMS growth and 20d SPX returns falls below 0.1 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI above 2.5% signals rising inflation, which may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 2.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 90th percentiles indicates strong aggregate demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS and HOUST both above 90th percentile) fails to predict positive 5d returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of robust consumer demand (RSAFS above 450,000), the S&P 500 experiences positive returns over the next 60 days due to elevated corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 450000.
